plan: PLAN.md Phase 3: export to ONNX, confirm outputs match PyTorch within tolerance, benchmark ONNX Runtime against PyTorch on CPU (p50 and p95 latency)
models: the shipped EfficientNet-B0 v2 checkpoints, seeds 0 to 2 (results/phase2/overnight/v2/final_models.json in the volume), each checked by weight hash
export: torch.onnx.export with dynamo, outputs features (1,280-d penultimate) and logits, dynamic batch 1 to 1,024; one file per seed; the ensemble is the mean of the three softmax outputs, computed outside the graph as in Phase 2
parity_images: 512 validation images (positions drawn with numpy default_rng(0) from the clients' validation split), evaluation transform: resize 224, centre crop, ImageNet normalisation. No test image is used
failure: a tolerance miss is recorded in the results and fails the job; tolerances are not loosened afterwards

latency.where: Databricks serverless CPU (the job's machine; Render's free tier is not measured here)
latency.what: one image (batch 1), already preprocessed; PyTorch eval with no_grad against ONNX Runtime CPUExecutionProvider; per seed and for the 3-model ensemble
latency.how: 50 untimed warm-up calls, then 300 timed calls; p50 and p95 in milliseconds; thread counts and CPU count recorded

outputs.repo: results/phase3/onnx/results.json: parity, latency, versions, file hashes and sizes
